thread:
olivia: deploy-bot blocked GA for rc20 - SBOM license checker flagged ambiguous license for transitive dep 'fastjson-lite' (declared as 'BSD-3 OR Unknown'). tagging legal & security.
deploy-bot: automated alert: release-candidate rc20 blocked -> SBOM license ambiguity: fastjson-lite v1.4.2 shows dual-license field mismatch. Policy: all transitive licenses must be clearly identified or approved. See /sboms/rc20.json.
marcus: hmm vuln-scan is clean, but license churn could trigger enterprise legal holds. any quick signal on whether 'Unknown' is a packaging bug?
build-bot: build log shows upstream metadata had missing license tag on the npm package registry mirror. upstream package.json lists "BSD-3-Clause" but our mirror had corrupted metadata during sync (mirror-id: mirror-23).
tina: if it's just mirror metadata, can we re-sync and re-generate SBOM within 30m? That seems fastest.
legal: we need to be careful. enterprise customers have a strict whitelist; an 'Unknown' license will block GA for them. Options: (A) re-sync and re-submit SBOM, (B) request temporary limited carveout for non-enterprise/public rollout, (C) vendor attribution and license confirmation from upstream maintainer (can take days).
marcus: operationally, re-sync CI job should be quick. I can queue job to re-fetch package metadata and regenerate SBOM + re-run license-checker.
olivia: can we do a scoped publish for non-enterprise customers while we fix mirror? We have marketing window. propose: 4h non-enterprise soft-launch, 2% traffic, auto-unpublish if license evidence not attached within 4h.
legal: we will allow non-enterprise carveout if (1) mirror re-sync job is started immediately, (2) approval ticket AP-1788888888 is created with delegation + audit, (3) release notes clearly state enterprise deployments paused until license confirmed. We need the SBOM delta attached when ready.
sec-bot: security note: license ambiguity does not change runtime exploitability but affects redistribution obligations. enforce carveout: no on-prem or dedicated pools. Hosted public API ok with timebox.
marcus: queued re-sync job: ci/rc20/metadata-resync-901. ETA 18m. logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/ci/rc20/metadata-resync-901/logs
deploy-bot: preview command for soft-launch: ```/publish --image redwood/inference:rc20 --scope non-enterprise --timebox 4h --traffic 2% --rollback_on=error>0.5%``` deploy-bot will enforce scope and auto-unpublish.
olivia: I'll open approval AP-1788888888 and note the mitigation steps. updating release notes draft: "RC20: transient SBOM license metadata ambiguity for fastjson-lite; enterprise deployments paused until SBOM evidence; public soft-launch allowed under timebox."
build-bot: resync completed. regenerated SBOM attached: https://artifacts.redwood/sboms/rc20/rc20-sbom.json. license-checker result: fastjson-lite now identified as BSD-3-Clause.
legal: evidence received. verifying package metadata and upstream attribution. If verification passes, we can lift enterprise hold. I will attach confirmation to AP-1788888888.
sec-bot: license-check verification OK. No further security concerns.
legal: confirmation attached: https://approvals.redwood/AP-1788888888/evidence and vendor contact thread with upstream maintainer: https://vendor.redwood/fastjson-lite/maintainer-thread. Lifting enterprise hold.
deploy-bot: verification passed. Full GA allowed.
olivia: proceeding with full publish now. command: ```/publish --image redwood/inference:rc20 --scope all --release-notes https://docs.redwood/releases/rc20```
cs-team: notifying enterprise customers we briefly paused due to SBOM metadata; all clear and unpause messages sent.
marcus: closing thread  root cause was mirror metadata corruption; filed infra ticket infra/mirror-23 to harden registry syncs."
